Vendor profile

Allplan (Nemetschek)

ALLPLAN GmbH (Nemetschek Group) — German Pioneer in 3D Parametric Rebar Detailing, Precast Concrete & Bridge Infrastructure BIM

By GstarCAD Academy Engineering Editorial Board (Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.) Reviewed by GstarCAD Academy Editorial Team Last reviewed 2026-10-26 Editorial Process

1. Munich Structural Heritage & the SCIA / Precast Merger

Established in 1984 in Munich, Germany as the flagship CAD product of Prof. Georg Nemetschek, ALLPLAN GmbH is the definitive European authority in cast-in-place reinforced concrete, automated precast element fabrication (TIM/BImat), and parametric bridge engineering (Allplan Bridge). In 2024, Nemetschek merged structural analysis sister brand SCIA with Allplan to create an end-to-end structural design-to-build workflow.

2. Drawing File (Teilbild) Layering, Parasolid Core & PythonParts

  • Document-Based Project Structure (Teilbilder): Unlike single-file BIM tools, Allplan partitions building stories, formwork, and reinforcement cages across up to 9,999 discrete sub-drawing files (Teilbilder) that can be referenced concurrently across engineering teams.
  • Parasolid 3D Kernel & PythonParts API: Powered by the Siemens Parasolid kernel, Allplan automates complex 3D bar bending schedules (BVBS standard) and parametric civil retaining walls via open Python scripting (PythonParts).

3. Exchanging Formwork & Rebar DWG Sheets with GstarCAD

Structural engineering offices using Allplan for 3D bridge and rebar modeling rely on GstarCAD 2027 for site layout coordination, temporary shoring details, and 2D contractor transmittals. Exporting Allplan Teilbilder via custom .cfg DWG exchange profiles ensures 1:1 mapping of reinforcement bar marks and DIN line weights in GstarCAD.

When auditing ALLPLAN GmbH / Nemetschek Group (Munich, Germany) software inside a multi-vendor engineering environment, CAD administrators and PLM architects must account for the following binary format, kernel tolerance, and API specifications:

5. Enterprise Co-Existence, Migration & TCO Optimization Protocol

In production supply chains where upstream 3D models or BIM containers originate from ALLPLAN GmbH / Nemetschek Group (Munich, Germany) platforms, engineering IT directors optimize total cost of ownership (TCO) by deploying a tiered seat architecture centered on GstarCAD 2027 and DWG FastView:

  • Verified Data Exchange Pipeline: Map Allplan Teilbilder (sub-drawings) to GstarCAD layers via custom .cfg exchange profiles; validate 2D rebar bending schedules and formwork shop drawings in GstarCAD 2027 with 1:1 DIN line weights.
  • Eliminating Redundant Seat Rentals: Rather than purchasing high-cost authoring subscriptions for project managers, site engineers, estimators, CNC operators, and quality inspectors who primarily review geometry or annotate 2D DWG/DXF sheets, organizations equip 70%–80% of their workforce with GstarCAD Perpetual Floating Licenses (GstarLM) and FastView 3D.
  • Automated Database Hygiene Before Transmittal: Prior to archiving project deliverables or importing external vendor DWG exports into corporate PDM/CDE vaults, run GstarCAD's batch script sequence (-PURGE RegApps → OVERKILL → AUDIT Yes → INDEXCTL = 3) to guarantee sub-second opening times and zero proxy object corruption.
